artifacts.summary: 9-phase plan to make the context-index validation layer report true counts, regenerate line_count across all extension source index-entries.json, index the 14 orphaned context files, propagate corrections to the deployed index, and add two new gates to check-extension-docs.sh.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's extension loader, `M.append_index_entries` (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua) merges each extension's source `index-entries.json` into the deployed `.claude/context/index.json` with append-only, dedupe-by-path semantics: if an entry's `path` already exists in the target it is SKIPPED, never updated. `sync.lua` independently lists `index.json` in `CONTEXT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS`, so a full sync never overwrites it by file copy either. The combined effect is that the deployed context index is effectively append-only: any correction to an EXISTING entry's fields in the source store (line_count, summary, load_when, domain) will never reach the deployed index on redeploy, even via deploy-headless.sh. Only brand-new paths propagate. Any task planning to 'fix the source and redeploy' for an existing index entry must first change this merge function to upsert semantics, or its verification silently passes against an unchanged deployed artifact. The same write path is the natural home for the schema's optional top-level `version`/`generated` stamp, which the loader has never written.
